card.name: First word after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first word of body text that comes right after a numbered section heading in a drug label's highlights, such as 2.1 Dosage Information or 5.1 Embryo-Fetal Toxicity. It often falls on a word-start piece of a drug name or a verb like Select, Use or Do.

modes.label: Dosing and patient sections
modes.description: The opening word after a numbered heading about dosing or patient selection.
modes.example: 2.1 General Dosing Information<< Do>> not open, crush or break ribav

modes.label: Warning sections
modes.description: The opening piece of text after a numbered warning or contraindication heading, often the start of a drug name.

card.plain: It fires on the first word of the text that follows a numbered heading in a drug label summary.
